description: Use this when: the user asks which open notices their company should look at first today. Returns the 적격 notices whose deadline is more than 3 days away, nearest deadline first (up to 5), with the counts of 적격 / 확인 필요 / 부적격 and the page and report links. Same company input as check_eligibility. Do not use this when: the user searches by words or price (use search_notices).
name: top_notices
title: 먼저 볼 공고
